_comment: The eval type translates on translategemma-27b and paraphrases on humanizer-12b, both local vLLM models (a GPU). To serve gen and check there too, name venice-uncensored-fp8 for gen; paraphrase_check stays on the hosted default unless it names that model too. Without a GPU, name the hosted deepseek-v3.2 for translation and give the recipe a stages list without paraphrase.
